parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The State Security Service of Georgia (SSSG) has arrested three Chinese citizens in Tbilisi for allegedly attempting to illegally purchase two kilograms of uranium.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms the arrest of three Chinese citizens in Georgia for attempting to purchase two kilograms of uranium in October 2025.
